candidate.definition_en: To combine two or more things to form a whole, or to become accepted as part of a group or community.
candidate.explanation_ar: إنك تدمج حاجات مع بعض عشان يعملوا نظام واحد متكامل، أو شخص يندمج في مجتمع جديد.

senses.definition_en: To combine two or more things so that they work together effectively.
senses.explanation_ar: دمج شيئين أو أكثر معاً ليعملا كنظام متكامل.

senses.definition_en: To become part of a group or society and be accepted by them.
senses.explanation_ar: الاندماج في جماعة أو مجتمع والتأقلم معهم.

examples: We need to integrate the new software with the old system.
The policy aims to integrate immigrants into the community.
It takes time to integrate into a completely new culture.
candidate.mnemonic: افتكر 'Integer' 'رقم صحيح'.. بتجمع الكسور والأجزاء عشان تعمل واحد صحيح 'Integrated'.
